gpu_tip: ~16GB total at 128K context — the smallest Granite 4.2 8B build, for when nothing larger fits, with ~11GB of it KV cache, since all 40 of Granite's layers use full attention. Quality drops noticeably at 2-bit on a model this small, so the KV cache knob's q4_0 option on a larger rung is usually the better saving. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 3060 Ti) plus a 16GB DDR5 kit covers it via llama.cpp's layer offloading.
mac_tip: Needs ~16GB — a 16GB MacBook Pro (M4 or M5) is right at the limit; a 24GB config is safer.
